description: Counterexamples kept as deterministic regression fixtures. `cargo xtask check-counterexamples` requires each reproducer test to exist in its file and each fix commit to exist. Removing an entry is a trust-boundary change.

counterexamples.defect: A corrupted frame length made reopen truncate two committed Batches
counterexamples.seed_or_trace: frozen byte-level corruption in the record

counterexamples.defect: A multibyte path in a gap text exceeded the byte cap
A process killed mid-append made the Spool unopenable
counterexamples.seed_or_trace: death injected at each sync stage

counterexamples.defect: An oversized line produced a false suffix after a cursor restart
counterexamples.seed_or_trace: line longer than the bounded scan

counterexamples.defect: A recreated file reusing an inode was read as a continuation
A torn or empty coverage-unknown marker halted collection
An unremovable marker caused lines to be collected twice
A staged marker left by a failed write was ignored
last + 1 overflowed for a Strand at u64::MAX (debug panic, release wrap)
No test put a Spool file boundary at through + 1, so deleting an unacknowledged file went unnoticed
counterexamples.seed_or_trace: one Batch per sealed file, ACK through 3

counterexamples.origin: semantic mutant M-COL-RESET survived (semantic-kernels milestone, first mutant run)
counterexamples.defect: The Spindle counter test accepted an unchanged start time after a counter decrease, so keeping the old start went unnoticed
counterexamples.seed_or_trace: disk read counter 4096 then 512 on the same boot

counterexamples.defect: segments_to_delete summed sizes with saturation and subtracted from the saturated total, so it stopped deleting while the remaining Segments still exceeded the byte limit
counterexamples.seed_or_trace: Segment sizes [u64::MAX, u64::MAX, 5], byte limit 5: deleted 1 instead of 2

counterexamples.defect: counter_step returned a NaN or infinite rate on a row that is not a reset, which no answer can carry
counterexamples.seed_or_trace: two +inf values of one series (inf - inf = NaN); f64::MAX over one nanosecond (+inf)

counterexamples.origin: property test mutations_are_rejected_or_canonical (crates/fabric-properties/tests/observation.rs), first failure under cargo xtask checks --profile fast on 2026-10-02
counterexamples.defect: An FOB1 block whose string dictionary held two equal entries was accepted, and re-encoded to different bytes: the encoding was not canonical
